column1: # GifItUp key fingerprint emoji table v1 (ADR-0014). Never edit, reorder or extend: a fingerprint is 12 indices into this list,
# so any change makes two app versions show different emojis for one key. A new table is a new format (v2 label).
# index<TAB>code point<TAB>name. All Emoji_Presentation, Emoji 4.0 or older, one code point, in ascending code point order.
